//: Type-checks everything that CAN be type-checked. See README, 'Type checking'.
//why: A full-project `tsc` runs out of memory. Each server.tool() call with a zod shape triggers TS2589 ('Type instantiation is excessively deep'), costing ~90s and a great deal of heap for a single file; across the tool modules it exhausts a 13 GB heap. This is a property of the MCP SDK's ZodRawShape inference, not of this project's code, and it predates these config files. The tool-registration modules are therefore left to esbuild and the test suite; everything else is checked here, which is where the logic lives.
